source_derived_design_rules.lesson: Group contrast, sampler behavior, advantage construction, clipping, and loss aggregation define the realized treatment.
source_derived_design_rules.applied_rule: Do not pool task, reward, sampler, or runner cells as replications; report each in-scope cell.

source_derived_design_rules.lesson: Proxy reward and evaluation choices can diverge from actual held-out quality.
source_derived_design_rules.applied_rule: Every primary cell requires a fixed independent held-out outcome; online reward and ZVF/GU remain separate columns.

source_derived_design_rules.source: RLHF Book Appendix C practical variance guidance
source_derived_design_rules.lesson: Training variance and evaluation variance are different uncertainty sources.
source_derived_design_rules.applied_rule: Justify independent training-seed and evaluation-sample counts prospectively from power or precision targets; never count optimization steps or selected checkpoints as replications.

source_derived_design_rules.source: Harvard CS2824 policy-gradient global-convergence and coverage units, pinned course commit 5dcc34e3b861da632371645fb05aebb12a40d23c
source_derived_design_rules.lesson: Stationarity-to-performance statements depend on coverage and distribution-mismatch assumptions.
source_derived_design_rules.applied_rule: A missing corpus-task cell blocks transfer; it is not an implicit zero effect or an N/A without a prespecified rationale.

source_derived_design_rules.source: Harvard CS2824 approximation and estimation-error units, pinned course commit 5dcc34e3b861da632371645fb05aebb12a40d23c
source_derived_design_rules.lesson: Optimization, statistical estimation, approximation, and reward/verifier error are distinct.
source_derived_design_rules.applied_rule: Report seed uncertainty, held-out evaluation, and verifier error separately; do not infer capability from an optimization diagnostic.

post_submission_evidence.e1_summary: A later five-arm by eight-seed same-stack GSM8K audit is future-paper feasibility evidence only; its conservative re-audit leaves all four held-out comparisons inconclusive.
post_submission_evidence.boundary: It cannot make the submitted structure reviewable or fill the reviewed HumanEval, MATH, and tool-use matrix cells.
